newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World takes 9.6 pct of Beijing N.Star.
newsitem.headline: New World takes 9.6 pct of Beijing N.Star.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd said on Friday it would take 9.64 percent of the share capital of Beijing North Star Co Ltd (BNS), an upcoming H-share listing candidate, for about HK$400 million.
"We will take a strategic stake of about 9.64 percent of Beijing North Star for about HK$400 million," said So Ngok, director and assistant general manager of New World Development (China) Ltd.
"Through this investment, we can fill our gap in the property portfolio of including mid-price property (in Beijing)," So said.
So said the group would hold the Beijing North Star stake through its wholly-owned New World Development (China) unit.

Market sources said Chinese property play Beijing North Star was expected to issue 614.8 million H-shares at price ranging HK$1.99 to HK$2.32 per share in flotation. H-shares are Hong Kong-listed shares of China-incorporated enterprises.
They said about 57 percent of the issue would be placed internationally, 28 percent to New World Development, and 15 percent for initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The H-share IPO is expected to run from May 6 to 9 with dealing in the shares to begin on May 15.
"We will consider investing in other H-shares or China-plays if their investment strategy and business are in line with ours," So said.
So said New World Development (China) would also take about 0.875 percent of Beijing Enterprise, a Beijing-backed and Hong Kong-based company which was expected to seek a listing in May.
